_comment: Scenarios for MockDmpClient (DMP_MODE=mock, pick one with DMP_MOCK_SCENARIO). Employee selectors: 'employees' lists codes, 'range' is an inclusive [from, to] pair of employee codes. Times are Vietnam local HH:mm. In an override, 'managerConfirmed' marks a manager's presence confirmation in DMP (BR-30, v1.3) and 'arrivesAt' hides the row until that time of day D, as when DMP receives it late.

late.description: PNJP000008-PNJP000020 check in at 08:15, after the 08:10 cutoff (BR-30).

late-record.description: PNJP000008-PNJP000020 check in at 08:05, but the rows only reach DMP at 08:20 (BR-32 automatic restore).

forgot-to-check-in.description: PNJP000008-PNJP000020 have no attendance record at all.

manager-confirmed.description: PNJP000008-PNJP000014 forgot to check in and PNJP000015-PNJP000020 check in at 08:25; their manager confirms them in DMP, which the sync sees from 08:20 (BR-30, BR-32, v1.3).

morning-leave.description: PNJP000008-PNJP000020 are on morning leave and arrive at 13:00 (BR-35).

afternoon-leave.description: PNJP000008-PNJP000020 are on afternoon leave and check in at 07:45 (BR-35).

p4-demo.description: Every P4 attendance case in one day (scripts/demo-p4-data.mjs): 008-012 no check-in (011-012 for an admin to confirm), 013-014 at 08:15, 015-016 at 08:05 arriving 08:20, 017-018 manager-confirmed from 08:20, 019-020 manager-confirmed from 08:40 and 021-022 at 08:05 arriving 08:40 (after finalization), 023 on morning leave.

api-error.description: Every attendance and leave call fails, as when DMP is down.

too-little-data.description: DMP returns attendance for only the first 30% of employees (BR-34 safety check).
